title: Benchmark Stage Pipeline
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Open the seven elements of the three-stage benchmark pipeline, then answer four questions about what starts from what.

learningObjectives: The learner will explain how the three benchmark stages chain by opening each of 7 elements of the pipeline and then answering 4 questions about what starts from what, with at least 3 of 4 correct.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: Explain what would go wrong with the comparison between models if stage 2 started from the template instead of from the stage 1 output.
commonMisconceptions: Every stage starts from the template.
Stage 3 is one run for the whole book.
A run that hits its time limit loses what it wrote.
A run can change its starting directory.
assessmentOpportunities: Mastery is 3 of 4 correct on the first attempt.
